mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence rise.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods where HOUST showed a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) within a month signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a potential deflationary pressure, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer and business spending slows.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two quarters signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to an increase in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods where GDPC1 showed a sustained increase over two quarters.
